# Project Tracker

appgen generated this REST API from the app definition `project-tracker`,
with the FastAPI binding. Do not edit the generated files: change the app
definition, and run `appgen generate` again. Write your own code in the
extension files (`*_ext.py`), which appgen creates once and never
changes.

## Stack

- FastAPI 0.161 on Python 3.14
- Vertical slice architecture
- uv

## Commands

| Task               | Command                                   |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------- |
| Install            | `uv sync`                                 |
| Start the API      | `uv run fastapi dev app/main.py`          |
| Lint               | `uv run ruff check`                       |
| Check the format   | `uv run ruff format --check`              |
| Type check         | `uv run pyright`                          |
| Test               | `uv run pytest`                           |

The API documentation is at `/docs` when the API runs.

## Layout

Each entity of the definition is a vertical slice: one folder with all
the code of the feature.

| Folder                  | Content                                              |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `app/main.py`           | The entry point. It adds the router of each slice.   |
| `app/core/`             | Code that all slices share: settings, health, and schema bases. |
| `app/features/<slice>/` | One slice for each entity.                           |
| `tests/`                | The tests, with one folder for each slice.           |

A slice has these modules:

| Module       | Content                                                     |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `router.py`  | The router of the slice, with the prefix of the entity.     |
| `schemas.py` | The Pydantic schemas: create, update, and read.             |
| `enums.py`   | The enums of the enum fields, if the entity has some.       |

## Slices

| Entity | Slice | Path |
| ------ | ----- | ---- |
| Project | `app/features/projects/` | `/projects` |
| Task | `app/features/tasks/` | `/tasks` |
